evidence_policy: Only sourced qualitative claims are included. Numeric thickness, OTR, WVTR, seal strength and service ranges remain null until a source specifies the complete test conditions and package structure.

materials.name: Micro-perforated polyolefin film
materials.structure: Food-contact polyolefin film with engineered micro-perforations; polymer, gauge, hole geometry and seal layer are supplier-specific.
materials.oxygen_barrier: Perforations provide gas exchange; package O₂/CO₂ balance depends on produce respiration, film area, fill mass, hole geometry and temperature.
materials.moisture_barrier: Not characterized here. Water-vapor transfer and condensation must be measured for the complete pack.
materials.gas_permeability: Perforation-dependent; no universal OTR is assigned.
materials.sealability: Requires seal-layer and process validation on the actual converted pack.
materials.mechanical_strength: No comparable sourced value recorded; verify filled-pack puncture, drop and vibration performance.
materials.map_suitability: Candidate for product-specific produce MAP after gas-exchange design and measurement; no fixed gas recipe is supplied.
limitations: Perforation size/count and the produce load are not specified by the class name.
Temperature excursions can change respiration and in-pack gas composition.
A model recommendation does not establish a safe or attainable shelf life.

materials.name: High-permeability PE produce film
materials.structure: Food-contact polyethylene produce film; resin blend, gauge, perforation and additives are unspecified.
materials.oxygen_barrier: A produce film must be selected against the commodity respiration and package geometry; no oxygen-barrier grade is assigned here.
materials.moisture_barrier: Must balance product water loss with condensation; no WVTR value is assigned.
materials.gas_permeability: Supplier- and construction-specific; confirm O₂ and CO₂ transmission at intended temperature and humidity.
materials.sealability: Requires validation of the actual resin, seal layer and sealing conditions.
materials.mechanical_strength: No comparable sourced value recorded; supplier and filled-pack tests required.
materials.map_suitability: Possible produce-pack starting point only after respiration/permeability matching; do not assume a passive MAP equilibrium.
limitations: The broad PE family does not specify resin grade, gauge or gas transmission.
No material class alone predicts shelf life or microbial safety.

materials.name: Metallized flexible laminate
materials.structure: Metallized polymer laminate with a compatible food-contact seal layer; layer order, metallization and gauge are not specified.
materials.oxygen_barrier: A barrier laminate is a candidate when oxygen-sensitive quality is important; actual performance depends on the complete structure and flex damage.
materials.moisture_barrier: A barrier laminate is a candidate for moisture-sensitive dry foods; actual WVTR is construction- and test-condition-specific.
materials.gas_permeability: Not numerically characterized for this generic class.
materials.sealability: Seal layer and process window must be validated with the filled product and any gas-flush process.
materials.mechanical_strength: No comparable sourced value recorded; assess flex cracking and distribution damage on the finished pack.
materials.map_suitability: May be considered for an inert-gas-flushed dry snack only after residual oxygen, seal integrity and gas retention are verified.
limitations: A generic material label does not specify barrier performance.
Multilayer construction and metallization can limit sorting and recycling options.
Nitrogen supply gas does not establish zero residual oxygen.

materials.name: Aluminium-foil flexible laminate
materials.structure: Flexible laminate containing aluminium foil and polymer layers; foil gauge, layer order, adhesive and sealant are unspecified.
materials.oxygen_barrier: Used as a high-barrier structure in food packaging; no numeric OTR is transferred to this unspecified construction.
materials.moisture_barrier: Used as a high-barrier structure in food packaging; no numeric WVTR is transferred to this unspecified construction.
materials.gas_permeability: No numeric value recorded for this generic class.
materials.sealability: Sealant and sealing process must be validated; pinholes, folds and flex damage require package-level checks.
materials.mechanical_strength: No comparable sourced value recorded; finished-pack flex, puncture and distribution testing required.
materials.map_suitability: Potential high-barrier structure; MAP suitability depends on seal and package testing.
limitations: Structure and foil thickness are unspecified, so barrier values cannot be inferred.
Mixed-material construction is difficult to recycle in many existing collection streams.

materials.name: BOPP/CPP flexible pouch
materials.structure: Biaxially oriented polypropylene / cast polypropylene pouch; gauge, coatings, seal geometry and any additional layers are unspecified.
materials.oxygen_barrier: No numeric oxygen barrier is assigned; choose a measured construction against the product's oxygen sensitivity.
materials.moisture_barrier: No numeric WVTR is assigned; choose a measured construction against the product's moisture sensitivity.
materials.gas_permeability: Construction-specific; the class name is insufficient to set a transmission rate.
materials.sealability: CPP may form a seal layer in a converted pouch; confirm the actual structure and sealing window with supplier data.
materials.mechanical_strength: No comparable sourced value recorded; validate the converted pouch and distribution route.
materials.map_suitability: No MAP claim made for the generic class.
limitations: No gauge or barrier measurement is available for this class entry.
The suitability of a pouch depends on product moisture, oil, package size and seal quality.

materials.name: HDPE bottle
materials.structure: Food-contact HDPE bottle and compatible closure; resin grade, wall thickness, pigment, geometry and closure are unspecified.
materials.oxygen_barrier: No numeric barrier claim recorded for an unspecified bottle and closure.
materials.moisture_barrier: No numeric transmission claim recorded for an unspecified bottle and closure.
materials.gas_permeability: Not characterized for this container/closure system.
materials.sealability: Closure leakage and tamper evidence require package-level validation.
materials.mechanical_strength: No comparable sourced value recorded; verify filled-bottle handling and distribution performance.
materials.map_suitability: No gas flushing recommendation; maintaining pasteurized milk's required cold chain is essential.
limitations: This entry does not validate food-contact compliance or migration.
A package cannot compensate for inadequate pasteurization or temperature control.

materials.name: Freezer-grade polyethylene bag
materials.structure: Flexible polyethylene bag intended for frozen-food use; grade, gauge and seal construction are supplier-specific.
materials.oxygen_barrier: No numeric oxygen-barrier value recorded for this unspecified bag.
materials.moisture_barrier: Package integrity and moisture transfer must be checked for the complete construction.
materials.gas_permeability: No numeric gas transmission data recorded.
materials.sealability: Validate the actual seal under the intended frozen fill and handling conditions.
materials.mechanical_strength: No comparable sourced value recorded; test cold flexibility, puncture and seal performance on the actual product.
materials.map_suitability: No MAP claim made for the generic class.
limitations: No freezer-temperature service limit is asserted without a supplier specification.
The cold chain and process remain outside the ML model.

materials.name: Woven PP sack with sealed PE liner
materials.structure: Woven polypropylene outer sack with an independent food-contact polyethylene liner; liner seal and dimensions are unspecified.
materials.oxygen_barrier: The woven outer layer is not treated as a gas barrier; the liner construction requires supplier data.
materials.moisture_barrier: Moisture protection depends on the liner and its closure/seal; no numeric WVTR is available.
materials.gas_permeability: Liner-dependent; the woven outer sack is not a hermetic barrier.
materials.sealability: The inner liner needs its own validated closure; stitching of the outer sack is not a barrier seal.
materials.mechanical_strength: No comparable sourced value recorded; bulk-load and transport testing required.
materials.map_suitability: No MAP claim made for this generic bulk structure.
limitations: The class is a prototype bulk-format option; pack size and liner material are not defined.
Do not infer hermetic storage performance from a woven outer sack.
